blocks.en: The Disciple now stands there, having accomplished the 8 previous virtues.
blocks.ro: Discipolul se află acum acolo, după ce a împlinit cele 8 virtuți anterioare.

blocks.en: He stands in the doorway to the Heavens and is about to enter them. He has never seen anything like this before in all of existence.
blocks.ro: El stă în pragul Cerurilor și este pe punctul de a intra în ele. Nu a mai văzut niciodată ceva asemănător în întreaga existență.

blocks.en: In front of Him appear these symbols: A Golden Pentagram, the Color Green, and the Supernal Light of the Cosmos.
blocks.ro: În fața Lui apar aceste simboluri: O Pentagramă Aurie, Culoarea Verde și Lumina Cerească a Cosmosului.

blocks.en: “Great is Queen Aphrodite in Her Final Mystery,” the Disciple thinks to Himself. But that is His Final thought. He knows the Symbols. The Gods will grant him passage to Eternity.

emphasis.text: “Great is Queen Aphrodite in Her Final Mystery,”

blocks.ro: «Mare este Regina Afrodita în Misterul Ei Final», Își spune Discipolul. Dar acesta este Ultimul Său gând. El cunoaște Simbolurile. Zeii îi vor îngădui trecerea în Eternitate.

blocks.en: Instead of speaking, He stands silent, with no more questions.
blocks.ro: În loc să vorbească, El rămâne tăcut, fără alte întrebări.

blocks.en: There is nothing more to utter, because He finally has understanding.
blocks.ro: Nu mai este nimic de rostit, căci în sfârșit El are înțelegere.

blocks.en: He cannot pronounce any hymn; He is the hymn and the psalm. He can only listen and experience.
blocks.ro: Nu poate rosti niciun imn; El este imnul și psalmul. Poate doar să asculte și să trăiască experiența.

blocks.en: His Task is now Complete.
blocks.ro: Sarcina Sa este acum Împlinită.

blocks.en: Ancient Greek Code Prayer
blocks.ro: Rugăciunea codului în greaca veche

blocks.en: Ἡ Τελείωσις
blocks.ro: Ἡ Τελείωσις

blocks.en: Ὦ Ἀφροδίτη, ἡ πρὸς τελείωσιν ἄγουσα,
blocks.ro: Ὦ Ἀφροδίτη, ἡ πρὸς τελείωσιν ἄγουσα,

blocks.en: ἐπὶ τῆς οὐρανίου πύλης ἐν σιγῇ ἑστήκαμεν·
blocks.ro: ἐπὶ τῆς οὐρανίου πύλης ἐν σιγῇ ἑστήκαμεν·

blocks.en: δέξαι τὸν ἄφωνον ὕμνον τῆς τετελειωμένης ψυχῆς.
blocks.ro: δέξαι τὸν ἄφωνον ὕμνον τῆς τετελειωμένης ψυχῆς.

blocks.en: Transliteration
blocks.ro: Transliterare

blocks.en: Ō Aphroditē, hē pros teleiōsin agousa, epi tēs ouraniou pylēs en sigēi hestēkamen; dexai ton aphōnon hymnon tēs teteleiōmenēs psykhēs.
blocks.ro: Ō Aphroditē, hē pros teleiōsin agousa, epi tēs ouraniou pylēs en sigēi hestēkamen; dexai ton aphōnon hymnon tēs teteleiōmenēs psykhēs.

blocks.en: Meaning
blocks.ro: Sens

blocks.en: New Ancient Greek prayer composed for this page. This new prayer voices the completion scene as a silent hymn before Aphrodite.
blocks.ro: Rugăciune nouă în greaca veche, compusă pentru această pagină. Această nouă rugăciune exprimă scena împlinirii ca pe un imn tăcut înaintea Afroditei.

blocks.en: The Ethic in Ancient Greek
blocks.ro: Principiul etic în greaca veche

blocks.en: Ὁ μαθητὴς νῦν ἕστηκε, τὰς ὀκτὼ προτέρας ἀρετὰς τελέσας.
blocks.ro: Ὁ μαθητὴς νῦν ἕστηκε, τὰς ὀκτὼ προτέρας ἀρετὰς τελέσας.

blocks.en: Ἐπὶ τῆς οὐρανίου πύλης ἵσταται καὶ μέλλει εἰσελθεῖν· οὐδὲν τοιοῦτον πρότερον ἐθεάσατο.
blocks.ro: Ἐπὶ τῆς οὐρανίου πύλης ἵσταται καὶ μέλλει εἰσελθεῖν· οὐδὲν τοιοῦτον πρότερον ἐθεάσατο.

blocks.en: Πρὸ αὐτοῦ φαίνεται χρυσοῦν πεντάγραμμον, χρῶμα χλωρόν, καὶ τὸ ὑπερουράνιον φῶς τοῦ κόσμου.
blocks.ro: Πρὸ αὐτοῦ φαίνεται χρυσοῦν πεντάγραμμον, χρῶμα χλωρόν, καὶ τὸ ὑπερουράνιον φῶς τοῦ κόσμου.

blocks.en: «Μεγάλη ἡ βασίλισσα Ἀφροδίτη ἐν τῷ ἐσχάτῳ μυστηρίῳ», νοεῖ· ἔσχατος δ᾽ οὗτος ὁ λογισμός. Τὰ σύμβολα γιγνώσκει· οἱ Θεοὶ τὴν δίοδον εἰς αἰωνιότητα δώσουσιν.
blocks.ro: «Μεγάλη ἡ βασίλισσα Ἀφροδίτη ἐν τῷ ἐσχάτῳ μυστηρίῳ», νοεῖ· ἔσχατος δ᾽ οὗτος ὁ λογισμός. Τὰ σύμβολα γιγνώσκει· οἱ Θεοὶ τὴν δίοδον εἰς αἰωνιότητα δώσουσιν.

blocks.en: Ἀντὶ λόγου σιωπᾷ· ἐρώτημα οὐδὲν λοιπὸν ἔχει.
blocks.ro: Ἀντὶ λόγου σιωπᾷ· ἐρώτημα οὐδὲν λοιπὸν ἔχει.

blocks.en: Οὐδὲν ἔτι λέγει· τέλος γὰρ συνίησιν.
blocks.ro: Οὐδὲν ἔτι λέγει· τέλος γὰρ συνίησιν.

blocks.en: Ὕμνον οὐ δύναται προφέρειν· αὐτὸς ὕμνος καὶ ψαλμὸς γέγονεν· ἀκούει μόνον καὶ βιῶν γιγνώσκει.
blocks.ro: Ὕμνον οὐ δύναται προφέρειν· αὐτὸς ὕμνος καὶ ψαλμὸς γέγονεν· ἀκούει μόνον καὶ βιῶν γιγνώσκει.

blocks.en: Τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ τετελείωται.
blocks.ro: Τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ τετελείωται.

blocks.en: Hē Teleiōsis · Transliteration
blocks.ro: Hē Teleiōsis · Transliterare

blocks.en: Ho mathētēs nyn hestēke, tas oktō proteras aretas telesas.
blocks.ro: Ho mathētēs nyn hestēke, tas oktō proteras aretas telesas.

blocks.en: Epi tēs ouraniou pylēs histatai kai mellei eiselthein; ouden toiouton proteron etheasato.
blocks.ro: Epi tēs ouraniou pylēs histatai kai mellei eiselthein; ouden toiouton proteron etheasato.

blocks.en: Pro autou phainetai khrysoun pentagrammon, khrōma khlōron, kai to hyperouranion phōs tou kosmou.
blocks.ro: Pro autou phainetai khrysoun pentagrammon, khrōma khlōron, kai to hyperouranion phōs tou kosmou.

blocks.en: «Megalē hē basilissa Aphroditē en tōi eskhatōi mystēriōi», noei; eskhatos d᾽ houtos ho logismos. Ta symbola gignōskei; hoi Theoi tēn diodon eis aiōniotēta dōsousin.
blocks.ro: «Megalē hē basilissa Aphroditē en tōi eskhatōi mystēriōi», noei; eskhatos d᾽ houtos ho logismos. Ta symbola gignōskei; hoi Theoi tēn diodon eis aiōniotēta dōsousin.

blocks.en: Anti logou siōpai; erōtēma ouden loipon ekhei.
blocks.ro: Anti logou siōpai; erōtēma ouden loipon ekhei.

blocks.en: Ouden eti legei; telos gar syniēsin.
blocks.ro: Ouden eti legei; telos gar syniēsin.

blocks.en: Hymnon ou dynatai propherein; autos hymnos kai psalmos gegonen; akouei monon kai biōn gignōskei.
blocks.ro: Hymnon ou dynatai propherein; autos hymnos kai psalmos gegonen; akouei monon kai biōn gignōskei.

blocks.en: To ergon autou teteleiōtai.
blocks.ro: To ergon autou teteleiōtai.

blocks.ro: Ritualul de Putere al Astartei (Afrodita)
